headline_marked: Century-old [[Jhalmal Cinema Hall destroyed]] by fire in Mymensingh
headline: Century-old Jhalmal Cinema Hall destroyed by fire in Mymensingh
summary: The historic cinema hall, once a zamindar mansion, and around 20 adjoining shops were gutted in a massive blaze that broke out early today.
details: A massive fire destroyed the historic Jhalmal Cinema Hall and approximately 20 adjoining business establishments in the Gauripur municipality of Mymensingh early today.
The blaze broke out around 2:15 am, reportedly starting at an LPG cylinder warehouse nearby, according to Purna Chandra Mutsuddi, assistant director of Fire Service and Civil Defence.
Four fire service units worked for nearly two hours to bring the flames under control.
The fire gutted the cinema hall and 15 to 20 nearby businesses, including the LPG warehouse, a decoration shop, and a second-hand clothing store.
Jhalmal Cinema Hall was housed in a century-old zamindar mansion that had been converted into a cinema hall over time.
Local administration and fire service officials are currently assessing the extent of the damage. Financial losses will be determined following a full investigation.

headline_marked: CCTV shows [[police officer helping drug dealer Raja escape]] in Dhaka
headline: CCTV shows police officer helping drug dealer Raja escape in Dhaka
summary: Sub-Inspector Prabir Kumar Biswas was caught on camera letting the accused 'Pichi Raja' out of a prison van during a transfer to Kashimpur Jail.
details: CCTV footage has revealed that a police officer helped notorious drug dealer 'Pichi Raja' escape from a prison van in the busy streets of Tantibazar, Dhaka.
On September 27, a prison van carrying 30 prisoners was heading to Kashimpur Jail. At around 5:58 PM, Sub-Inspector (SI) Prabir Kumar Biswas opened the rear door and let two prisoners out.
The footage shows Pichi Raja and another prisoner, Khairul Bashar, stepping onto the road. While Bashar returned to the vehicle, Pichi Raja walked away accompanied by SI Biswas.
Gazipur Metropolitan Police Commissioner Israel Hawladar confirmed that both the officer and the drug dealer then entered a private car and fled the scene.
Police investigations reveal the escape was planned two days in advance, involving the van driver, Nayek Kamal Hossain, and the suspect's sister, Taslima.
SI Prabir Kumar Biswas, the driver Kamal Hossain, and Taslima have been arrested and placed on a four-day remand by a Gazipur court.
Pichi Raja, who faces 30 different cases, had been arrested on May 19 at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport upon returning from Nepal.
Law enforcement agencies have increased surveillance at borders to track down and recapture the fugitive drug dealer.
caption:
A police officer was caught on CCTV helping a drug dealer escape from a prison van in broad daylight.

CCTV footage has revealed that a police officer helped notorious drug dealer 'Pichi Raja' escape from a prison van in the busy streets of Tantibazar, Dhaka.

On September 27, a prison van carrying 30 prisoners was heading to Kashimpur Jail. At around 5:58 PM, Sub-Inspector (SI) Prabir Kumar Biswas opened the rear door and let two prisoners out.

The footage shows Pichi Raja and another prisoner, Khairul Bashar, stepping onto the road. While Bashar returned to the vehicle, Pichi Raja walked away accompanied by SI Biswas.

Gazipur Metropolitan Police Commissioner Israel Hawladar confirmed that both the officer and the drug dealer then entered a private car and fled the scene.

Police investigations reveal the escape was planned two days in advance, involving the van driver, Nayek Kamal Hossain, and the suspect's sister, Taslima.

SI Prabir Kumar Biswas, the driver Kamal Hossain, and Taslima have been arrested and placed on a four-day remand by a Gazipur court.

Pichi Raja, who faces 30 different cases, had been arrested on May 19 at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport upon returning from Nepal.

Law enforcement agencies have increased surveillance at borders to track down and recapture the fugitive drug dealer.
